title: Languages
description: Languages of the dashboard. Every text can be edited here; what is not edited follows the system text.
name: Name
addHint: Use the BCP 47 code, such as fr, it or es-MX. The language starts as a draft, with the Portuguese texts until it is translated.
autoTranslate: In each language, “Translate automatically” fills the texts still missing, to be reviewed later.

auto.title: Machine translation
auto.hint: Fills only the texts that have no translation in this language yet; edited or already translated texts do not change. Review them with the “Machine texts to review” filter: once saved, a text becomes manual.
auto.queued: Machine translation requested. It runs in the background; reload the page to see its progress.
auto.sourceLocale: The source language is not translated.
auto.remaining: {count} still missing; request again to continue.
